I booked a room through Agoda at a confirmed price of ₹1,565. However, when I arrived at the hotel in Delhi for check-in, the receptionist informed me that the room would cost ₹4,000. When I questioned this, she stated that the amount shown on Agoda was only for the “booking” and that I would need to pay extra directly to the hotel.
This was never mentioned during the booking process, and there was no transparency about any additional charges. It felt misleading and unfair. I ended up wasting my time and energy traveling to the property, only to face this situation.
I would strongly recommend future guests to be cautious before booking here. It may be better to choose a more reputable and transparent hotel to avoid unnecessary inconvenience.
